results.title: Anti-thromboinflammation of Triherbal Extract in Diabetic Rats
results.content: **Objective:** To evaluate the effects of a blended aqueous extract of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina on some markers of thromboinflammation in diabetic rats. **Conclusion:** This study revealed that the blended aqueous extracts of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina are non-toxic and may have synergistic effects in limiting thromboinflammation in a diabetic state. doi: 10.1186/s12933-023-01990-6. Effect of methanol moringa oleifera leaves extract on hematological parameters of alloxan induced diabetic wistar rats. Anti-diabetic potential of aqeous extract of moringa oleifera, occimium gratissium and Vernonia amygdalina in alloxan-induced diabetic rats. J Diabetes Clin Res 2020;2:78-85. doi: 10.33696/diabetes.1.023. doi: 10.1016/j.heliyon.2021.e08404. Bhavani T, Mohan RR, Mounica C, Nyamisha J, Krishna AG, Prabhavathi P, et al.
